The '''Tormentor device''' was a [[Torture/Legends|torture]] device used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Chaskar]] attempted to make the [[Hero of Tython]], his new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], use the device on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]], but the Hero had already broken free of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] will and [[Mind trick/Legends#Force_persuasion|Force persuaded]] Chaskar to leave.
